# CopilotForge - Copilot Adoption

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Design and run organisation-wide or business-unit Microsoft AI adoption programmes, from readiness and scenarios through launch, reinforcement and measurement.

- **Layer:** adoption
- **Lead role:** Adoption Lead
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-copilot-adoption`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`adoption-measurement`](skills/adoption-measurement/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Measure, Improve | Defines how Copilot adoption is measured across usage, capability, behaviour change and business outcomes, with baselines set before launch, team or role-level reporting above a minimum group size, and feedback loops that change the programme. Use when setting adoption measures, when a sponsor asks whether Copilot is working, or when someone proposes tracking individual usage. |
| [`adoption-readiness`](skills/adoption-readiness/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Mobilise | Assesses whether an organisation or business unit is ready to adopt Microsoft Copilot across sponsorship, licences assigned versus used, IT-led technical enablement, data and permissions hygiene, approved-use guidance, support and communications, and records the gaps to close before launch. Use when licences have been bought or are about to be, before a launch date is fixed, or when early use has stalled. |
| [`adoption-reinforcement`](skills/adoption-reinforcement/SKILL.md) | draft | Launch, Measure, Improve | Runs the always-on reinforcement cycle for Copilot after launch - a calendar of nudges and refreshers, scenario refreshes, manager follow-up prompts, re-engagement of teams whose use has faded and refreshers when Copilot changes - triggered by team-level signals, never individual tracking. Use when launch is over and use is plateauing, when teams drift back to old habits, or when a Copilot change must reach existing users. |
| [`adoption-support-model`](skills/adoption-support-model/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Launch, Improve | Designs the user support model for Copilot - self-help, Champions as first-line peer guidance, office hours, the IT service desk, admin escalation to Microsoft, the security route for suspected data exposure and the intake route for ideas - with triage categories, capacity and a feedback loop. Use when Copilot is about to launch, when Champions or the service desk are overwhelmed, or when nobody knows where Copilot questions go. |
| [`audience-segmentation`](skills/audience-segmentation/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Envision, Mobilise | Builds the adoption audience model for a Copilot programme by grouping the workforce on work pattern, Copilot access, device and shift constraints, information sensitivity and change impact, using aggregate HR and IT data, then sizing each audience and setting how it is reached, onboarded and supported. Use when one message is going to everyone, when waves need defining, or before personas and scenarios are chosen. |
| [`copilot-onboarding`](skills/copilot-onboarding/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Launch | Designs the onboarding experience each newly licensed or enabled Copilot user receives - access confirmed before the welcome, approved-use guidance in plain words, a first session on starting scenarios, first-week tasks and where to get help - as a repeatable flow for launch waves, new joiners and people changing role. Use when access is being switched on, when new joiners get Copilot with no guidance, or when onboarding was a one-off launch. |
| [`executive-enablement`](skills/executive-enablement/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable, Launch | Enables executives to use Copilot in their own work and lead its adoption visibly - private or small-group sessions on their real tasks, support for executive assistants and chiefs of staff, care with sensitive leadership content, and the visible behaviours that give others permission to experiment. Use when leaders hold licences but rarely use them, before a launch where executives go first, or when leaders' messages about AI ring hollow. |
| [`frontline-enablement`](skills/frontline-enablement/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Enable, Launch | Enables frontline and deskless workers to adopt AI safely - confirming with IT and the licensing route which experience and device each frontline audience can use, choosing a few shift-relevant scenarios, teaching in huddles and on mobile within paid time, involving supervisors and employee representatives, and adapting support and Champions. Use when frontline teams join a rollout, were left out of one, or found desk-based training useless. |
| [`launch-plan`](skills/launch-plan/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable, Launch | Plans a phased Copilot launch with onboarding by persona, executive and manager enablement, reinforcement through office hours and Champions, a support model and a feedback loop that keeps improving the programme. Use when readiness gaps are known and a rollout needs sequencing, when a big-bang launch is being proposed, or when a launch happened but nothing followed it. |
| [`role-based-adoption`](skills/role-based-adoption/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Launch, Scale | Designs an adoption journey for each priority role - first scenarios, guided practice on real work, team routines and later extension to Cowork tasks or agents - with role-specific onboarding, manager expectations, peer support, milestones and team-level success signals. Use when a role group needs more than generic onboarding, when a sponsor names priority roles, or when a role's use has stayed shallow. |
| [`scenario-discovery`](skills/scenario-discovery/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Envision, Enable | Segments the workforce into personas such as desk, hybrid and frontline workers, discovers role-based Copilot scenarios with business owners, prioritises them by value and frequency, and builds a scenario catalogue with prompt patterns that users can verify. Use when planning what people will actually do with Copilot, when usage is generic and shallow, or when a new team or role joins the rollout. |
